payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the same DVD object from the source image appear white in the edited image?
node.criteria: Track the source DVD—a small rectangular case/disc near the center of the source image—into the edited image using its location and distinctive shape/appearance. Complete only if that same object is clearly identifiable in the edited image and is white. Partial if the same object is clearly identifiable and has changed from black toward white but is not white. Absent if the same object is clearly identifiable and remains black with no requested change. Unknown if its identity or correspondence is unclear, it is missing, or evidence is insufficient; do not substitute another newly visible disc.
